24.         Address,
25.         PageAligned,
26.         PhysicalAddress,
27.         TruncatedMemoryRegion,
28.         VirtualAddress,
29.     },
30.     mm::phys::upool::Upool,
31. };
32. use ::alloc::collections::LinkedList;
33. use ::arch::mem;
34. use ::bitmap::Bitmap;
35. use ::sys::error::Error;
36. #[cfg(verus_keep_ghost)]
37. use ::vstd::prelude::*;
38. 
39. // Include specifications.
40. #[cfg(verus_keep_ghost)]
41. include!("mod.spec.rs");
42. #[cfg(verus_keep_ghost)]
43. include!("mod.proof.rs");
44.

46. // Exports
47. //==================================================================================================
48. 
49. pub use self::{
50.     kframe::KernelFrame,
51.     manager::PhysMemoryManager,
52.     upool::UserFrame,
53. };
54. 
55. //==================================================================================================
56. // Standalone Functions
57. //==================================================================================================
58. 
59. #[verus_verify(external_body)]
60. #[verus_spec(result =>
61.     requires
62.         phys_view().initialized,
63.         phys_view().inv(),
64.     ensures
65.         phys_view().inv(),
66.         phys_view().initialized,
67.         match result {
68.             Ok(_) => phys_view().frames.all_reserved(
69.                 phys_regions_frame_set(&physical_memory_regions)),
70.             Err(_) => true,
71.         },
72. )]
73. fn book_physical_memory_regions(
74.     physical_memory_regions: LinkedList<TruncatedMemoryRegion<PhysicalAddress>>,
75. ) -> Result<(), Error> {
76.     info!("booking physical memory regions ...");
77. 
78.     // Book physical memory that is not usable.
79.     for region in physical_memory_regions.iter() {
80.         info!("booking: {:?}", region);
81.         frame::alloc_range(region)?;
82.     }
83. 
84.     Ok(())
85. }
86. 
87. #[verus_verify(external_body)]
88. #[verus_spec(result =>
89.     requires
90.         phys_view().initialized,
91.         phys_view().inv(),
92.     ensures
93.         phys_view().inv(),
94.         phys_view().initialized,
95.         match result {
96.             Ok(_) => forall|a: int|
97.                 #[trigger] mmio_regions_frame_set(mmio_regions).contains(a)
98.                     && phys_view().frames.covers(a)
99.                     ==> phys_view().frames.reserved(a),
100.             Err(_) => true,
101.         },
102. )]
103. fn book_mmio_regions(
104.     mmio_regions: &LinkedList<TruncatedMemoryRegion<VirtualAddress>>,
105. ) -> Result<(), Error> {
106.     info!("booking memory-mapped i/o regions ...");
107. 
108.     // Book memory-mapped I/O regions.
109.     for region in mmio_regions.iter() {
110.         info!("booking: {:?}", region);
111.         let mut start: usize = region.start().into_raw_value();
112.         let end: usize = start + (region.size() - 1);
113.         while start < end {
114.             let mmio_addr: usize = crate::hal::platform::gva_to_gpa(start);
115.             let phys_addr: PageAligned<PhysicalAddress> = PageAligned::from_address(unsafe {
116.                 // MMIO GPAs may legitimately lie outside tracked RAM, so they must not go through
117.                 // the regular physical-address validator here.
118.                 PhysicalAddress::from_mmio_address(VirtualAddress::from_raw_value(mmio_addr))?
119.             })?;
120. 
121.             // Only book frames that the frame allocator actually tracks.
122.             // MMIO regions above RAM (e.g. the LAPIC at 0xFEE0_0000) are not
123.             // covered by the bitmap and must be skipped.
124.             if frame::is_covered(phys_addr) {
125.                 frame::book(phys_addr)?;
126.             }
127.             start += mem::FRAME_SIZE;
128.         }
129.     }
130. 
131.     Ok(())
132. }
133. 
134. ///
135. /// # Description
136. ///
137. /// Initializes the physical memory manager.
138. ///
139. /// # Parameters
140. ///
141. /// - `physical_memory_regions`: Physical memory regions to book.
142. /// - `mmio_regions`: Memory-mapped I/O regions to book.
143. /// - `physical_memory_layout`: Physical memory layout bitmap.
144. ///
145. /// # Returns
146. ///
147. /// Upon success, `Ok(())` is returned. Upon failure, an error is returned instead.
148. ///
149. #[verus_spec(result =>
150.     requires
151.         phys_view().inv(),
152.     ensures
153.         phys_view().inv(),
154.         match result {
155.             Ok(_) => {
156.                 &&& phys_view().live()
157.                 &&& phys_view().frames.all_reserved(
158.                     phys_regions_frame_set(&physical_memory_regions))
159.                 &&& forall|a: int|
160.                     #[trigger] mmio_regions_frame_set(mmio_regions).contains(a)
161.                         && phys_view().frames.covers(a)
162.                         ==> phys_view().frames.reserved(a)
163.             },
164.             Err(_) => true,
165.         },
166. )]
167. pub fn init(
168.     physical_memory_regions: LinkedList<TruncatedMemoryRegion<PhysicalAddress>>,
169.     mmio_regions: &LinkedList<TruncatedMemoryRegion<VirtualAddress>>,
170.     physical_memory_layout: Bitmap,
171. ) -> Result<(), Error> {
172.     // Initialize frame allocator singleton.
173.     info!("initializing the frame allocator ...");
174.     // Safety: called exactly once during single-threaded boot.
175.     unsafe { frame::init(physical_memory_layout)? };
176.     book_physical_memory_regions(physical_memory_regions)?;
177. 
178.     book_mmio_regions(mmio_regions)?;
179. 
180.     // Initialize user page pool.
181.     info!("initializing the user page pool ...");
182.     let upool: Upool = Upool::new();
183. 
184.     // Initialize physical memory manager singleton.
185.     info!("initializing the physical memory manager ...");
186.     PhysMemoryManager::init(upool)?;
187. 
188.     Ok(())
189. }
